case_number: 2025 INSC 295; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 722 OF 2012; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1266 OF 2012
summary: Eyewitness testimony (PW-1) reliability; sole eyewitness as relative/employee; corroboration requirement; FIR delay (2-day magistrate forwarding); weapon recovery issues; postmortem inconsistencies (stomach injury absent); medical evidence consistency; High Court affirmed conviction under Sections 302/149 IPC; life imprisonment upheld; appeal allowed due to unreliable testimony and lack of corroboration.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.302, s.148, s.149
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction set aside; appellants acquitted.
